evals.prompt: Cut lesson.mp4 from 00:01:12.5 to 00:02:05 exactly, speed it up to 1.25x, resize it to 1280x720, keep the audio synchronized, and save lesson-short.mp4 without overwriting an existing file.
evals.expected_output: A frame-accurate H.264/AAC edit at 1280x720 with synchronized 1.25x audio, or an explicit skipped result when the destination exists.
expectations: The bundled edit_video.py script is used in precise mode.
Start, end, speed, size, and output arguments match the request.
Existing output is not overwritten without --overwrite.

evals.prompt: Add intro.mp4 before main.mov and outro.mp4 after it. The files have different sizes and one clip has no audio. Produce a 1920x1080 30 fps published.mp4 with continuous audio handling.
evals.expected_output: A normalized 1920x1080, 30 fps concatenation in intro-main-outro order, with silence synthesized for a missing audio stream.
expectations: The bundled concat_videos.py script is used with --intro and --outro.
Precise mode normalizes the clips to 1920x1080 and 30 fps.
The clip without audio receives a silent audio stream rather than breaking concatenation.

evals.prompt: Join part-1.mp4 and part-2.mp4 without re-encoding or quality loss. Remove the final audio track and write joined-muted.mp4. Explain any timing or compatibility limitation.
evals.expected_output: A lossless stream-copy concatenation with no audio, or a clear compatibility failure before editing.
expectations: Video stream compatibility is checked before concatenation.
The response explains that stream copy requires compatible inputs and keyframe boundaries affect lossless cuts.
